description: This PHP trait defines validation rules for LDAP configuration parameters, including common parameters, data mapping, and user lookup settings in an LDAP authentication plugin for OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Returns a collection of parameter rules for LDAP configuration parameters, including validations for enabling LDAP, hostname, port, encryption, implementation, bind settings, data mapping, and sync interval.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForDataMapping
methods.description: Returns validation rules specifically for LDAP user data mapping fields such as first name, middle name, last name, status, email, and employee ID.

methods.name: getParamRuleCollectionForUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Provides validation rules for user lookup settings such as base distinguished name, search scope, user name attribute, search filter, employee selector mapping, and related parameters.
